claims.text: The quality of singing voice is evaluated using Mean Opinion Score (MOS), which assesses audio quality based on naturalness and similarity to the original voice.
Factors such as pitch control and timbre similarity significantly influence the perceived quality of the converted singing voice.
The proposed methods for singing voice conversion aim to improve quality by addressing pitch representation and musical expression.
